description:
A desktop mod manager for games supported by ModWorkshop.

Modrex is a free, open-source desktop mod manager for PAYDAY 3, PAYDAY 2,
PAYDAY: The Heist, and Crime Boss: Rockay City. Browse, install, organize,
update, enable, and disable mods from ModWorkshop, then launch each game
modded or vanilla directly from the app.
Added
- Added graphics config shortcuts for PAYDAY 3 and Crime Boss: Rockay City.
- Added movie replacements for PAYDAY 3 on the Microsoft Store.
- Added PAYDAY 3 heist, story and tutorial movies to movie replacements.
- Added Ready or Not support for the Epic Games Store and Microsoft Store.
Changed
- Movie replacements offer only movies found in the game folder.
- Movie replacements preselect files with a clear destination.
- Movie replacements describe each game movie and show the mod author's instructions.
Fixed
- Fixed Engine.ini presets for PAYDAY 3 on Steam not applying in game.
- Fixed newer .bk2 movie mods being rejected.
- Fixed unused movie and INI backups piling up on disk.
- Fixed dropped movie and INI files getting stuck on Installing.
- Fixed MP4 movie mods made with ffmpeg being rejected.
- Fixed some windows still showing the old scrollbar.
- Fixed Nexus mods installed by drag and drop not being recognized.
- Fixed endless loading cards for mods installed from a dropped archive.
- Fixed Epic copies not being found when Epic kept an old install record.
Thanks to @illianezheviasov and @TarekLP for contributing to this release.
Release created by @ShulhaOleh.
